title: 2048 with Save
description: Slide and merge number tiles to reach 2048, then save your board as an image file and load it later. Free to play in your browser.
about:
2048 with Save is the classic sliding number puzzle with one handy extra: you can keep any game for later. Every move slides all tiles on the 4x4 board, and two tiles with the same number merge into their sum. Keep combining until you build the 2048 tile, then carry on for an even higher score if you like.

The SAVE button downloads your current board as a small PNG picture that secretly holds the whole game, including your score. Press LOAD and pick that file to continue exactly where you left off, even days later. Your unfinished game and best score are also remembered automatically in this browser.

It is a relaxing yet tricky puzzle for anyone who likes numbers, planning ahead and beating their own record.
howToPlay: Swipe anywhere on the screen, or use the arrow keys or W A S D, to move all tiles up, down, left or right at once. When two tiles with the same number collide, they merge into one tile worth their sum and add to your score. A new 2 or 4 appears after every move. Reach the 2048 tile to win; the game ends when the board is full and no merges are left. Press SAVE to download the board as a picture and LOAD to continue it later.

controls.action: Slide the tiles on touch screens (anywhere on the screen)
Slide the tiles with the mouse
Use the SAVE, LOAD and NEW GAME buttons
Drop a saved PNG on the board to load it

tips: Keep your biggest tile in one corner and build the rest of the board around it.
Use mostly two or three directions and avoid the one that pulls your big tile out of its corner.
Press SAVE before a risky move so you can load the file and try a different plan.
Keep a row full of large tiles so it does not shift when you slide sideways.

faq.question: Is 2048 with Save free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. It is completely free and runs in your browser with no sign-up or download.

faq.question: Can I play it on my phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. Swipe anywhere on the screen to move the tiles; the board resizes to fit your phone or tablet in portrait and landscape. SAVE and LOAD work too, and your current game is also kept automatically in this browser.

faq.question: How does saving work?
faq.answer: SAVE downloads a PNG image that contains your board and score. Press LOAD and pick that file (or drop it onto the board) to restore that game at any time.
